resources.string: During a session, if you open an app that isn\'t on your whitelist, blockit uses Android\'s Accessibility Service to bring you back to the block screen. It doesn\'t read any screen content and doesn\'t collect or share any data. Without this service, blockit can\'t block your phone. On the next screen, turn on \"%s\".

blockit can hold on even without that service: with device administrator it can turn the screen off on its own, and with usage access it still recognises the app in front. Turn on the backup lock to set them up.
The system keeps the lock service switched on but no longer runs it, so a session would not block anything. Open accessibility settings, then turn the blockit switch off and on again.

The backup can lock the screen now, but it still cannot tell one app from another: the apps in your bag would be blocked too.\n\nWith usage access, blockit recognises the app in front and your bag keeps working even when the accessibility service is down.
Lets blockit lock the screen when the accessibility service is not available.

During your last session the system stopped blockit's accessibility service, so the block could no longer tell which app was open.

A backup lock stops that from happening again: with device administrator, blockit can turn the screen off on its own, without that service.

One thing to know: while the backup is on, blockit cannot be uninstalled. To remove it, first turn the backup off in Settings, Security, Device admin apps, then uninstall as usual.

Every day with at least five minutes of session lays a block. Seven blocks make a floor, and the floors become your tower. If you skip a day the tower falls: a reserve block can save it.\n\nAnd those who reach day one hundred... will find a surprise.

Every 10 days in a row you earn a reserve block (up to 3). If you miss a day, a reserve block repairs the tower on its own and your streak survives. When they run out, only a parachute can save the fall. If the tower falls completely, your reserves start over from zero.

This is your ticket to break free from smartphone addiction

Do Not Disturb turns on by itself when the block starts and off when it ends, so nothing buzzes on the table while you are focused. Calls follow your own Do Not Disturb rules, and blockit reads nothing.

Rain is free with this update: switch it on from the tile in the block screen. Waves, white noise and a distant city are the sound pack, a one-time add-on with no subscription. All generated live and fading out on their own as the session ends.
Already Premium? The sound pack is separate: Premium keeps everything it has, the pack adds the sounds.
